prompts.name: human-feeling-landing
prompts.text: Create a landing page with iroha-css. Use semantic wa-* classes, data-wa-theme="ai", restrained color, asymmetry, wa-editorial or wa-split for the first viewport, and no generic centered gradient hero.

prompts.name: settings-form
prompts.text: Create a settings form with iroha-css. Use wa-form, wa-field, wa-input, visible labels, wa-field--invalid with aria-invalid and wa-error, and wa-cluster for actions. Do not invent class names.

prompts.name: operations-dashboard
prompts.text: Create a compact operations dashboard with iroha-css. Use data-wa-theme="sumi" data-wa-density="compact" data-wa-contrast="high", wa-sidebar, wa-grid, wa-table, wa-stat, wa-donut, wa-progress, and wa-meter. Keep chart values accessible.

prompts.name: component-catalog
prompts.text: Create a component catalog with iroha-css. Use wa-grid for samples, theme comparison via data-wa-theme on sample cards, copyable HTML snippets, and accessibility notes for CSS-only interactive surfaces.

prompts.name: repair-generic-ai-layout
prompts.text: Refactor this UI to use iroha-css. Replace invented classes with documented wa-* classes, remove raw colors, reduce nested cards, and choose layout primitives from wa-stack, wa-grid, wa-split, wa-sidebar, wa-editorial, and wa-reel.

prompts.name: settings-page-recipe
prompts.text: Create a production settings page with iroha-css. Use wa-page-header, wa-settings-section, wa-form, wa-switch, wa-input-group, wa-action-bar, visible labels, and no invented classes.

prompts.name: filterable-data-recipe
prompts.text: Create a filterable data screen with iroha-css. Use wa-app-shell, wa-page-header, wa-filter-bar, wa-search, wa-segmented-control, wa-table-wrap, wa-table, wa-drawer for optional detail, and accessible text values.

globalRules: Use docs/ai/class-decision-tree.md before adding custom CSS.
Use data-wa-theme, data-wa-density, and data-wa-contrast for parent-level tuning.
Keep behavior for tabs, modals, dropdowns, and toasts in application code.
